headline: Oil prices close higher on Friday but drop 13% for the week
summary: Crude oil prices closed higher on Friday as investors weighed the potential impact of Democratic midterm election victories on the conflicts involving the US, Israel, and Iran.
why: Crude oil is a primary global commodity input that directly influences worldwide inflation expectations, transportation costs, and energy sector equities.

impacts.name: Crude Oil
impacts.why: Oil prices recorded a 13% decline over the course of the week despite Friday's bounce.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Prices declined over the week amid shifting political expectations and geopolitical evaluations following the US midterm elections.
